target.title: fix #99163: harden large chat attachment parsing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Large clipboard image data URLs currently pass through whole-string base64 validation and full-payload MIME sniffing. For multi-megabyte attachments this does unnecessary work on the hot path and can make attachment parsing much more expensive than the small header sniff actually needs.

## Summary

- replace chat attachment base64 validation regex with an iterative scanner so large clipboard payloads avoid whole-string regexp matching
- move the stack-safe large-payload fix into `canonicalizeBase64`, preserving full malformed-tail validation for shared callers
- make MIME sniffing decode only a small canonical base64 prefix after full payload validation
- add regression coverage for ~1.9MB PNG clipboard data URLs, large shared canonicalization, and malformed data after a valid PNG prefix

Fixes #99163.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — 127 passed across media-core, media sniffing, and gateway shards
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs packages/media-core/src/base64.ts packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts` — passed
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.non-agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-non-agents.tsbuildinfo` — passed
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 packages/media-core/src/base64.ts packages/media-core/src/base64.test.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.ts src/media/sniff-mime-from-base64.test.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.ts src/gateway/chat-attachments.test.ts` — passed
- `git diff --check` — passed

Note: this revision preserves the shared `sniffMimeFromBase64` full-input validation contract that ClawSweeper flagged. A valid PNG prefix with an invalid base64 tail now returns `undefined`, while large valid payloads still sniff from a bounded decoded prefix and avoid full-payload `Buffer.from(..., "base64")` on the gateway path.
